name: Katherine Gorge
objection: It is the same draw as the Nitmiluk National Park spot (park boat and walks); placement should merge or distinguish them (gorge departure point vs park), or it is a near-duplicate under rule 3.

name: Jatbula Trail
objection: Needs a permit and a ferry hop, so few visitors do it; still named in two counted sources.

name: Sweetwater Pool
objection: Part of the Edith Falls/Leliyn walking network and a destination of a walk, not a separate draw; only one real guide listing.

name: Southern Rockhole
objection: It lies on the Jatbula Trail (rule 3: part of a larger spot) and is not a stop most day visitors reach.

name: Keep River National Park
objection: One counted source; remote on the WA border. A Parks NT page is blocked, so not independently confirmed.

name: Goorrandalng Walk
objection: Part of Keep River National Park (rule 3), one source; the park spot already stands for it.

name: Jarnem Lookout Walk
objection: Part of Keep River National Park (rule 3), single source, tiny audience.

name: Limmen National Park
objection: Remote, 4WD-oriented and sparse visitor infrastructure; one counted source.

name: Southern Lost City
objection: Single source, 35 km off the highway on a gravel road; may be just part of Limmen National Park.

name: Butterfly Springs
objection: Single source and mostly a campground; part of the Limmen National Park draw.

name: Mataranka Thermal Pools
objection: Inside Elsey National Park (the kept park spot) so could be counted as part of it; but the pool is the named draw and a distinct place.

name: Bitter Springs
objection: Near-duplicate of Mataranka Thermal Pools in appeal and closed in the wet season; single counted source.

name: Mataranka
objection: The draw is the pools and park, already spots; a town is a spot only when the town itself is a draw (Wikivoyage names mostly a supermarket and campgrounds).

name: Never Never Museum
objection: Single source, a small local museum, hours unverified.

name: Douglas Hot Springs
objection: Remote, 130 km north of Katherine on a gravel road, and the main pool is a short visit.

name: Cutta Cutta Caves Nature Park
objection: Closed in the wet season; guided tours only.

name: Umbrawarra Gorge Nature Park
objection: Gravel road, wet-season closures and remote.

name: Butterfly Gorge Nature Park
objection: Single source, reached by unsealed roads and often closed; short visit.

name: Caranbirini Conservation Reserve
objection: Single source, 46 km from the very remote Borroloola, and a near-twin of Southern Lost City.

name: Gregory's Tree
objection: A ten-minute roadside look and a minor historic marker; kept only because a guide singles it out by name.

name: Escarpment Walk
objection: Part of the Judbarra / Gregory park spot (rule 3).

name: Calcite Flow Walk
objection: Single source, on a 4WD-only road 14 km past Bullita, part of the park spot.

name: Giwining Nature Park
objection: Swimming is not allowed (crocodiles), it is 130 km out of Katherine, and it is mostly camping.

name: Timber Creek
objection: A tiny roadhouse town; its only draws are the park spots, so a wrapper of them.

name: Lake Copperfield
objection: Single source and a simple local swimming spot.

name: National Trust Museum (Pine Creek)
objection: Single source and it also houses the library; a small local museum.

name: Grove Hill Heritage Museum
objection: It is a licensed hotel with camping, so the museum is a side of a hotel; a long detour.

name: Pine Creek
objection: Its own draws are minor and rejected here; a town is a spot only when the town itself is a draw.

name: Top Didj Cultural Experience
objection: A private operator and gallery shop rather than a place; the case rests on the experience being a permanent venue.

name: Katherine Museum
objection: A small regional museum; some visitors skip it.

name: Katherine School of the Air
objection: One counted source and lessons depend on school term; hours unverified.

name: Old Borroloola Police Station Museum Heritage Precinct
objection: Single source, remote, and the building is the main thing; hours unverified.

name: Borroloola
objection: Remote, with little to do in town, and its draws are the park spots (a wrapper).

name: Larrimah Museum
objection: Single source, tiny museum, hours unverified, a stop only for those passing by.

name: Daly Waters
objection: The listing gives no specific attraction and the core draw is a pub (a venue); it is a quirky roadside icon kept as a stop.

name: Daly River
objection: A large river area rather than one place; its draws are fishing and camping, with no single stop identified.
